summary.value: B.Tech Information Technology undergraduate with a strong foundation in software development, full-stack development, backend engineering, Data Structures & Algorithms, databases, and AI-driven applications. Kusal has built projects including an offline RAG pipeline with a custom vector database and a multi-tenant pharmacy management SaaS platform. His technical background includes Python, Java, C, SQL, Next.js, Node.js, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Supabase, REST APIs, Docker, and Git.
